title: Muscles and movement
examples: Teacher, if I bend my arm, what muscle is pulling?
Do all the muscles in my body work together?
What connects the muscle to the bone?

explain.say: Muscles only pull on bones to make you move.

draw.text: Muscles pull, they do not push.

explain.say: Think about bending your arm at the elbow joint.
Muscles usually work in pairs to help you move.
Tendons are strong cords that attach muscles to bones.
When you kick a football, your leg muscles pull the shin bone.
In everyday life, think about opening a heavy door.

faq.q: Why do muscles work in pairs?
faq.a: Muscles work in pairs because one muscle must relax while the other pulls. This balance keeps your joints from getting hurt.
asks: Do I need two muscles to move?
Why can't one muscle do everything?

faq.q: What is the job of a tendon?
faq.a: A tendon acts like a strong rope, connecting the muscle to the bone so the pull can happen.
asks: Does the tendon connect muscle to muscle?

faq.a: No, muscles can only pull. They create tension that pulls on the bones attached to them.

faq.q: Which muscles are in my arm?
faq.a: The biceps is on the front and the triceps is on the back of your upper arm.
asks: What is the muscle on the back of my arm?

faq.q: What is the difference between a muscle and a tendon?
faq.a: The muscle is the stretchy tissue that pulls, and the tendon is the tough cord that attaches it.
asks: Are muscles and tendons the same?

facts: Muscles create movement by pulling on bones.
Muscles usually work in opposing pairs.
The biceps and triceps are common arm muscle pairs.

quiz.say: When you bend your elbow, which muscle is primarily pulling?
quiz.why: The bicep muscle is on the front and pulls the forearm bones together when you bend your elbow.

wrong.0: The triceps is the muscle on the back; it pulls when you straighten your arm.
wrong.1: The tendon is the cord, not the muscle that does the pulling.
wrong.2: The bone is what gets pulled, it does not do the pulling.

quiz.say: If a muscle pulls, what action is it performing?
quiz.why: Muscles can only generate tension, which results in a pulling action on the bones.

wrong.0: Stretching is what happens when the muscle is relaxed, not the action of movement.
wrong.1: Resting means no action, but movement requires a pulling force.
wrong.3: Muscles cannot push; they must always pull something else.
